<thought>To obtain the precursors, I will search the template catalog for a Horner‑Wadsworth‑Emmons (HWE) reaction template using only bond criteria (since the required functional‑group names are not available). Then I will apply the found template to each of the three target SMILES provided earlier, collect all precursor sets, and return them in the requested list‑of‑lists format.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "bonds_formed": ["C=C"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-P", "C-O"],
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
